vb_textbox.text: There are four different coloured gnomes that appear in sets of two. Purple and yellow & green and red. I found that when a gnome yields a decent amount of mushrooms, it usually continues but once it stops, the other gnome is the one that usually does more. It varies over time so I'd suggest trying out each one to begin with and see which yields more then go for that one until it runs dry then you can switch.
